replace.description:
Real value -> the stand-in a scrubber writes for it ("my-home-wifi": "HomeNet"). Every real value here is also forbidden: the
leak check fails on it anywhere in the published tree, any case, with spaces, `-` and `_` interchangeable, and a MAC address in
every spelling (aa:bb.., AA-BB.., aabb..).

Default: {}.

forbid.description:
Values that are forbidden with no stand-in: an e-mail address, a serial number, a disk's UUID, a street, a town.

Takes a list of texts. Default: [].

name.description:
The name and e-mail address an exported commit carries (lares publish refuses without them). Use GitHub's no-reply address
(Settings > Emails), not your own: a public commit shows it to everyone.

Takes a text. Default: "".
